EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement” is dated as of July 9", 2014
by and between Maik Lankau (“Executive”) and Luxoft USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation with
its principal business address at 100 Wall Street, Suite 503, New York NY 10005 (the
“Corporation”). Certain capitalized terms are defined in Section 8 of this Agreement.

BACKGROUND

In consideration of Executive’s employment with the Corporation and receipt of
compensation paid to Executive by the Corporation, and the Corporation’s agreement to provide
Executive with its Confidential Information, the Corporation and Executive agree to the
following terms and conditions.

OPERATIVE TERMS
1. Scope and Purpose. The Corporation desires to assure itself of Executive's

employment, and Executive desires to be employed by the Corporation on the terms and
conditions set forth in this Agreement.

Zs Start Date (“Effective Date”). The start date for of Executive’s employment
shall be August 15", 2014.

A Employment and Duties. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement,
the Corporation shall employ Executive as the Managing Director — Telecommunications and
Embedded Systems or in another management position assigned to Executive by the
Corporation’s Board of Directors (the “Board”). In particular, Executive shall be accountable
for profitable growth of business relationships with selected clients of the Corporation, he shall
serve as line manager for all personnel involved in service delivery. Executive is expected to
contribute to expansion of the Corporation’s business in worldwide with a particular focus on
North America, being a key member of the regional management team. A more detailed outline
of the Executive’s responsibilities is set forth on Exhibit A to this Agreement, which is
incorporated in and made part of this Agreement. Executive shall report to Vice President of
Technology Services of the Corporation. Executive accepts such employment and agrees to
devote his full time and attention to the business and affairs of the Corporation.

4. Compensation and Benefits. As consideration for all of Executive’s services to
the Corporation, Executive shall receive the following while Executive is employed by the
Corporation:



(a) Base Salary. The Corporation shall pay Executive a base annual salary of
Three Hundred Thousand Dollars ($300,000) (as adjusted from time to time, the “Base
Salary”), which shall be payable by the Corporation in regular installments in accordance
with the Corporation’s general payroll practices (as in effect from time to time).
Executive’s Base Salary for any partial year will be based on the number of days actually
elapsed in that year. Executive’s Base Salary shall be subject to annual review for
adjustment at the discretion of the Board (any salary so adjusted shall thereafter be the
Base Salary for purposes of this Agreement). The next salary adjustment is scheduled for <—
April 1, 2015.

(b) Annual Bonus. The Executive shall have the right to receive an annual bonus
in the amount of $140,000 (“Annual Bonus”), which shall be paid to Executive semi-
annually, provided that (i) the Executive remains an employee of the Corporation in good
standing on the date of payment, and (ii) Executive satisfies the Key Performance
Indicators (“KPI”) established by the Corporation in accordance with its standard KPI
system for the position held by Executive provided that for the period between the
Effective Date and December 31, 2014 the KPI execution shall be set to 100%.

(c)  401(k) Plan Participation. Executive shall be entitled to a matching
contribution by the Corporation under its 401(k) Plan (the “Plan”) in an amount
commensurate with Executive’s position in accordance with standard policies of the
Corporation, commencing at such time when the Company is able to make such matching
contribution under the Plan (“Contribution Start Date”). Prior to the Contribution Start
Date, Executive shall have the right to receive a bonus in the amount of $18,000
(“Additional Bonus”), which shall be paid to Executive at the end of each fiscal year of
the Corporation between the Effective Date and the Contribution Start Date. Additional
Bonus shall be prorated for any time period that is less than twelve (12) calendar months.

(d) Other Benefits. In addition to (but without duplication of) the Base Salary
and any bonus, while Executive is employed by the Corporation, Executive shall be
eligible to participate in the Stock Option Plan (subject to approval by the Board and the
Corporation’s policies), and such other pension, life insurance, health insurance,
disability insurance and other employee benefits plans, if any, which the Corporation may
from time to time make available to its executive employees generally. Executive shall
also be entitled to twenty (20) working days of paid vacation per year. Executive shall
also be entitled to sick days, vacation days and accrual and carryover of such days and
unused vacation days in accordance with the standard policies of the Corporation (as in
effect from time to time). Nothing in this Agreement will preclude the Corporation from
amending or terminating any of the programs applicable to executive employees so long
as such amendments apply to all similarly situated employees.

(e) Expenses. Executive shall be reimbursed by the Corporation for all
reasonable out-of-pocket business expenses incurred by Executive in the performance of
Executive’s duties and responsibilities under this Agreement in accordance with the
Corporation’s standard policies regarding expense verification, reporting, documentation
and reimbursement practices.


5. Termination.

(a) Executive understands, acknowledges and agrees that Executive is an “at-
will” Employee, and that Executive’s employment by the Corporation will terminate (i)
automatically and immediately upon Executive's death or Disability, and (ii) may be terminated
by the Corporation (through action by the Board) for any reason or no reason, whether with or
without Cause, at any time by giving Executive notice of the termination, subject only to the
contractual rights upon termination set forth herein; provided that if the Corporation terminates
the Executive without Cause, the Executive shall be entitled to ninety (90) days prior notice to be
given by the Corporation. The terms of this Agreement, therefore, do not and are not intended to
create either an express or implied contract of employment with the Corporation for any
particular period of time. Executive may terminate his employment by the Corporation by
giving the Corporation written notice of at least ninety (90) days in advance of his termination
date; provided that upon receipt of notice of termination from Executive, the Corporation may, in
its sole discretion, request that Executive cease employment activities prior to the termination
date specified in accordance with this Section 4, and Executive shall comply with such request, it
being understood that such request will not change the termination date specified in accordance
with this Section 4 or affect the characterization of the termination of Executive’s employment.

(b) Except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement, Executive shall not be
entitled to any other salary, bonuses. employee benefits or compensation from the Corporation
after his termination, and all of Executive’s rights to salary, bonuses, employee benefits and
other compensation hereunder which would have accrued or become payable after his
termination (other than vested retirement benefits accrued on or prior to the termination or
expiration of his employment, accrued insurance benefits or other amounts owing under the
Corporation’s standard, Board-approved policies as of the date of such termination or expiration
that have not yet been paid) shall cease upon such termination or expiration, other than as
expressly required under applicable law (such as COBRA).

(c) The Corporation may offset any bona fide amounts not in dispute that Executive
owes It against any amounts it owes Executive under this Agreement.

6. Restrictive Covenants.

Scope and Purpose. Executive acknowledges that the Corporation is engaged in the
business of providing to its customers, whether directly or through one or more subsidiaries,
custom software and/or application development, custom software or application maintenance,
offshore software development, software architecture services, software quality assurance, IT
strategy consulting and software process consulting (the “Business”). Executive acknowledges
and agrees that during the course of his employment with the Corporation, he will have access to
valuable and confidential professional and business information of the Corporation, its
substantial relationships with prospective and existing service recipients, clients, and customers,
trade secrets, and similar information. Executive further acknowledges and agrees that it is
essential to the conduct of the Corporation’s business, the sale of its products and the provision



of its services and to the protection of its shareholders’ investments that the foregoing
information be kept confidential and that its professional and business relationships be protected.

Other Restrictions, Executive represents and warrants to the Corporation that the
Executive is not a party to any restrictive covenant limiting his right to perform services for the
Corporation in any capacity whatsoever.

Conflict of Interest. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four
(24) months after termination of this Agreement, the Executive hereby agrees, for himself and
for any existing or future company affiliated with him, not to, directly or indirectly, in any
capacity, either for himself or on behalf of another person, engage in any new transactions, deals
or relations of any kind including but not limited to the following: own an interest in, Manage,
control, become employed in any position by, enter into a contract, or accept an obligation from,
any third party, inconsistent, or incompatible with interests or obligations of the Corporation or
any Affiliate thereof (as defined below), represent, participate in or be connected to the
management or control of (1) any business which competes with the Business of the Corporation
or any of its Affiliates as currently conducted or proposed to be conducted (each of the
foregoing, a “Competitive Enterprise”); or attempt to influence the Corporation’s customers to
place their business with any other individual or business, and in recognition of the international
and national nature of the business of the Corporation, this restriction shall apply throughout the
Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Europe and the United States (the “Territory”).

Non-Solicitation of Clients. During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of
twenty-four (24) months after termination of this Agreement, the Executive hereby agrees not to,
in any manner, directly or indirectly, for himself and for any existing or future company
affiliated with any thereof, (a) Solicit a Client to transact business with a Competitive Enterprise
(either for himself or on behalf of another person or entity) or to reduce or refrain from doing any
business with the Corporation or any Affiliate thereof or (b) interfere with or damage (or attempt
to interfere with or damage) any relationship between the Corporation or any Affiliate thereof,
on the one hand, and a Client, on the other hand (capitalized terms used but not defined herein
are defined below).
